title: Specter v3
description: The hero a bot holds and the avatar it shows, as served by the assignment view. A bot has a hero only after the user picked one or asked for a random one (assignedBy picked or random), or because it was given one automatically before the assignment step existed (assignedBy auto); a bot with no hero is not a Specter and appears only in specters v3 unassignedBindingIds. Once assigned, the hero never changes. heroId, ordinal, name, epithet, personality and appearance are fixed authored content, not generated, and imply no role, capability or lane. ordinal is 1 for the first bot to hold a hero, 2 for the next, and so on per hero; displayName is name for ordinal 1 and name plus a Roman numeral from ordinal 2 (digits above 3999); the client never composes it. bindingId is the only reference to the bot (the bot-binding contract's opaque id, never a Crew id). version is the avatar revision, 0 when the user has never changed the avatar; a client sends it back as expectedVersion on POST /api/specters/{bindingId}/portrait and on POST /api/specters/{bindingId}/hero, and a mismatch is a 409. Assigning a hero does not change version. portrait is always present: the hero's own bundled portrait when avatarChosen is false, otherwise the avatar the user picked; the embedded portrait always has dataBase64 null. createdAtMs is when the hero was assigned. source is always roster. A Specter is cosmetic: nothing here is an agent setting, permission, experience value or level.
